description: This file contains implementations of string utility functions, including case conversion, comparison, trimming, whitespace collapsing, character checks, byte formatting, substring replacement, string joining, and placeholder substitution. It also defines related classes and structs used internally.

classes.name: ReplacementOffset
classes.description: Struct used to track the position of replaced parameters in string placeholders.

classes.name: SubstringMatcher
classes.description: Template struct for matching substrings within strings.

classes.name: CharacterMatcher
classes.description: Template struct for matching individual characters within strings.

methods.name: ToLowerASCII
methods.description: Converts a string view to lowercase ASCII.

methods.name: ToUpperASCII
methods.description: Converts a string view to uppercase ASCII.

methods.name: CompareCaseInsensitiveASCII
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive ASCII comparison between two strings.

methods.name: EqualsCaseInsensitiveASCII
methods.description: Checks equality of two strings ignoring ASCII case.

methods.name: ReplaceChars
methods.description: Replaces specified characters in a string with another string.

methods.name: RemoveChars
methods.description: Removes specified characters from a string.

methods.name: TrimString
methods.description: Trims specified characters from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: TrimWhitespace
methods.description: Trims whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: CollapseWhitespace
methods.description: Collapses sequences of whitespace characters into a single space.

methods.name: ContainsOnlyChars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only specified characters.

methods.name: DoIsStringASCII
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only ASCII characters.

methods.name: IsStringASCII
methods.description: Checks if a string view contains only ASCII characters.

methods.name: IsStringUTF8
methods.description: Checks if a string view is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: LowerCaseEqualsASCII
methods.description: Checks if a string equals a given ASCII string ignoring case.

methods.name: StartsWithCaseInsensitiveASCII
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix ignoring case.

methods.name: EndsWithCaseInsensitiveASCII
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix ignoring case.

methods.name: HexDigitToInt
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal digit character to its integer value.

methods.name: IsUnicodeWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a character is a Unicode whitespace character.

methods.name: FormatBytesUnlocalized
methods.description: Formats byte size into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: ReplaceStringPlaceholders
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a format string with provided substitutions.

methods.name: JoinString
methods.description: Joins a list of strings with a separator into a single string.
